title: Raw DXF entity event adapter capture bounds
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Bound the dx_iface adapter copy of unsupported/raw DXF entity events retained in block order.
Keep incomplete capture sticky across reads into an existing dx_data and fail export before publication.
Add generated tests for successful accounting and each resource/owner refusal without persistent fixtures.

behavior: Moves dx_iface::addRawDxfEntity from an inline unbounded vector copy to an out-of-line bounded capture function.
Enforces aggregate limits of 100000 events, 4000000 groups, and DRW::kMaxDxfBinaryPayloadBytes logical bytes per retained dx_data.
Charges the ordered event slot once and includes raw record dynamic strings, group slots/string/binary values, and retained source spellings.
Advances event/group/byte counters only after successful vector insertion; missing owner, exceeded budget, and allocation failure set a sticky fail-closed flag.
Removes the import-start reset of rawDxfEntityCaptureFailed so a prior partial retained model cannot become exportable by beginning another read.
implementation.compatibility: No DRW_Interface callback contract or class layout changed. dx_data gained internal adapter accounting fields. Raw entity order and payload schema are unchanged. The 64 MiB cap is logical storage accounting, not allocator-capacity or RSS measurement.

commands: git diff --check -- dwg2dxf/dx_data.h dwg2dxf/dx_iface.h dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp tests/CMakeLists.txt DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md
testCoverage: successful raw entity event insertion with exact logical bytes and typed-event index
byte-budget rejection, sticky capture failure, and export refusal without output
